subject: GCP mid-cycle ledger proof package and VAT allocation for disputed invoice
messages:
From: Laura Kim <billing@stitchpoint.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (mid-cycle) - entity split / VAT

Hi Evelyn,

We’re reconciling our October GCP Marketplace invoice and found a mid-cycle allocation that seems to have been attributed to the wrong merchant entity. The posted invoice (INV-20261001) shows a $48,270 charge for marketplace usage, but our internal ledger indicates $12,345 of that usage should have been billed to our US entity (StitchPoint LLC) rather than the EU entity (StitchPoint Ltd). Because this affects VAT pass-through, our tax team needs the usage-level evidence + entity mapping so we can file the correct VAT reclaim.

What we need from Redwood to close this on our side:
- Per-transaction usage export for 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-11 (project IDs, usageIDs, SKU, quantity, charge)
- Proof of which GCP listing/merchant ID was used for the billed lines
- Any migration/change logs if you recently remapped project->entity

I attached a short summary of our findings (stitchpoint_inquiry_20261012.pdf). Can you confirm receipt and let me know when we can expect the data? We’re on a tax filing deadline so a response by EOD Wed (10/14) would be ideal.

Thanks,
Laura Kim
Senior Finance Manager — StitchPoint
attachments: stitchpoint_inquiry_20261012.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <billing@stitchpoint.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (mid-cycle) - entity split / VAT

Hi Laura — thanks for the detailed note and the PDF. We received the invoice you referenced and Marissa and I started a first-pass reconciliation. I’m looping in Jonas (platform billing) to pull the canonical usage export.

Action items from Redwood:
- Jonas to export per-transaction usage for 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-11 and flag any duplicate usageIDs.
- We’ll provide the merchant/listing mapping and the redwood->entity attribution table.
- If we confirm a mis-attribution, we will request a credit from GCP and provide you with the credit ticket ID and expected timeline.

I’m attaching the initial usage extract and our current entity mapping for your review. If that looks good we’ll escalate to GCP immediately. Proposed short call Thursday 10/16 11:00am PT to align on the evidence bundle and next steps — does that work for you?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Finance Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_usage_export_20261001-10.csv, redwood_entity_map_20261019.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (mid-cycle) - entity split / VAT

Evelyn / Marissa — ran an automated sweep on the usage export you attached. Findings:
- Found ~1,120 lines matching StitchPoint project IDs.
- Identified 24 usageIDs that were duplicated across two listings (project: sp-prod-analytics / SKU: compute:preemptible) — the duplicates are the likely cause of the $12,345 mis-attribution.
- Root cause appears to be an ingestion edge-case where a project was temporarily mapped to the EU merchant ID during an internal listing cutover (logs attached).

Suggested remediation plan:
1) Generate a corrected per-line invoice allocation file for GCP (we can create the line-level JSON they accept).
2) Open a GCP support credit request (I’ll file with the titles and attach the usage export + dup_usage_report_20261015.txt).
3) Provide StitchPoint the redwood_entity_map_20261019.xlsx + the line-level allocation file for your VAT team to confirm.

I’ll prepare the credit request today and will post the GCP ticket number once submitted. Tentative credit amount estimate: $12,345.00 (net).

-Jonas
Billing Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: dup_usage_report_20261015.txt
From: Laura Kim <billing@stitchpoint.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@stitchpoint.io
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (mid-cycle) - entity split / VAT

Evelyn / Jonas — appreciate the quick triage and the detailed notes. We reviewed the usage extract and the duplicate report. The evidence is sufficient for our tax team to accept a reallocation credit, provided the corrected invoice/credit memo includes a VAT breakdown by entity.

Can you confirm the estimated timeline for:
- GCP credit ticket creation and ticket ID?
- Expected time-to-credit (approx days)?
- Delivery of corrected invoice (PDF) showing VAT per entity?

If you can get the ticket ID and a corrected invoice to us by EOD Fri (10/22) our tax team can proceed with the reclaim without additional documentation. Otherwise they’ll need a formal attestation letter which will add ~2 weeks to our process.

Thanks again — looking forward to the ticket ID and confirmation.

Regards,
Laura Kim
Senior Finance Manager — StitchPoint
attachments: none
